summary.text: Holly B. Stover, a Democrat, represents House District 48 (Boothbay, Boothbay Harbor, Edgecomb, South Bristol, Southport and Westport Island, Lincoln County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Boothbay. The House profile lists membership on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs, Ethics and Government Oversight committees.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives non-profit director as the occupation and lists Nasson College and the Muskie School of Public Service, with degrees dated 1983.

Listed affiliations include the Community Board of Lincoln Hospital, the Boothbay Region District Nurses Association, Boothbay Railway Village, the Maine Council of Churches and the Boothbay Region Water District.
It lists one child and two grandchildren.
